notices.title: Notice of Public Hearing: Steeplechase Phase 2 Amended Subdivision Request
notices.agenda_text:
Posted on May 29, 2026 on the Utah Public Notice Website www.utah.gov/pmn/ Draper City Website www.draperutah.gov/news/ and at Draper City Hall, 1020 E. Pioneer Road, Draper, UT

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: Steeplechase Phase 2 Amended Subdivision Request

Notice is hereby given that Draper City will hold a public hearing before the Planning Commission to receive public comment on the above listed request. The property is located at approximately 13229 S. Springdale Way. The purpose of the request is to amend the location of the property line between Lot 44 and Parcel D within the Steeplechase Phase 2 Subdivision, inclusive of relocating associated easements, HOA open space, and extending the buildable area for the currently platted Lot 44 accordingly.

The hearing will be held at Draper City Hall in the City Council Chambers, on June 11, 2026 at 6:30 p.m. The complete notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website; www.utah.gov/pmn/, Draper City Website; www.draperutah.gov/news/, and at Draper City Hall.

To request a copy of the public notice or for additional inquiries contact Todd Draper at (801) 576-6335 or todd.draper@draperutah.gov.  

Dated this 29th Day of May, 2026

Attest: Nicole Smedley, City Recorder
